label: class_a_02_ecology_01_old_00
text: Hello, hello. I hope everyone’s ready to learn\nsome new things today![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_02_ecology_02_old_00
text: Did you all try using the ZR Button to let your\nPokémon out as I taught you in our last class?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_02_ecology_03
text: Walking along with your Pokémon lets you see\nhow unique and cute they all are.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_02_ecology_04
text: I’d also highly recommend picnics for when you\nwant to spend some quality time together with\r\nthe Pokémon in your party.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_02_ecology_05
text: You can get them all around the table to make\nsandwiches and play—it’s really a lot of fun![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_02_ecology_06
text: If you want to learn more about making food,\nMr. Saguaro’s class is the best place to go![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_02_ecology_07
text: Now, sometimes, while you’re enjoying a picnic\nwith your Pokémon...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_02_ecology_08
text: you may find something very, VERY important in\nthe basket next to your table![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_02_ecology_09
text: This very important something is what Pokémon\nare born from. Let’s all say it together![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_02_ecology_11
text: It’s not clear where these Eggs come from, but\nthey’re probably placed in the basket rather\r\nstealthily by the Pokémon at the picnic.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_02_ecology_12
text: Walking around with an Egg will help warm it,\nwhich allows it to hatch.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_02_ecology_13
text: Eggs won’t warm up by sitting in Boxes, though.\nYou need to have them in your party![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_02_ecology_14
text: And here’s one more super important thing I’d\nlike you to remember about Eggs.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_02_ecology_15
text: Pokémon entrust us with their Eggs because they\nbelieve in us![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_02_ecology_16
text: So, I sure would be happy to see you all being\nresponsible parents for your little Pokémon Eggs![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_02_ecology_17
text: Whoops. My most important point came right as\nthe bell rang. Well, see you all next time, I guess![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
